M1.title: Curve and variable offset
M1.notes: No plate-specific calibration. Native dash patterns and offset interpolation differ.

M2.title: Variable-width brush
M2.notes: Calibrated mode changes the width law to match the source's offset-fit envelope. It is not a same-width-law comparison.

M3.title: Latitude spheres
M3.notes: Nominal mode replays MetaPost's scaled random stream for sphere-latitude brush dashes. Calibrated mode uses seed 15 and remains a visual-only comparison.

M4.title: Longitudinal arc tube
M4.notes: Calibrated mode slightly increases maximum hatch width (TeX pt).

M5.title: Suspended sphere composite
M5.notes: Native annotation and arrow construction differ. MetaPost draws the tube before the sphere and uses one global RNG. Use C1 for an isolated sphere measurement.

M6.title: Variable-radius closed tube and taper
M6.notes: Typst reverses the sine sign to account for its opposite circle traversal; this is coordinate conversion. Calibrated mode changes the seed of both tubes.

M7.title: Transverse tube
M7.notes: Calibrated mode changes the dash period (TeX pt). Both modes keep the same drawing resolution.

C1.title: Isolated concentric sphere
C1.notes: No plate-specific calibration. This isolates the sphere from M5's tube and annotations.

S101.title: Stippled brush, sphere and tube
S101.notes: No extra per-plate overrides. The existing Typst density defaults were calibrated previously; they are not upstream parameters. The source uses one global RNG, while Typst uses separate keyed streams.

M8.title: L'Hôpital pulley composites
M8.notes: Uses the port's composed L'Hôpital pulley helper with source dimensions and placements. Grain, pulley shading and labels use native algorithms.

M9.title: Wood-grain panels
M9.notes: Same four panel bounds and grain angles; nominal mode uses the source knot-warped field and 1 mm sampling grid, with deterministic per-panel knot seeds and approximate contour widths.

M10.title: Mechanical and optical primitives
M10.notes: Same layout and nominal primitive dimensions. Weight profile, spring construction, lens curves, arrowheads and labels use native algorithms.

M11.title: Globe, eye, knot and refraction
M11.notes: Uses all eight upstream coast polylines and the new latitude-hatching globe mode; knot strands use longitudinal tube fills and over/under gaps. Latest 600 ppi trial: whole RMSE 0.13134 (baseline 0.24449), globe 0.18935 (baseline 0.49895), knot 0.17410 (baseline 0.30447). Globe ink coverage is close; knot is under-inked. The two source-masked globe shading layers and exact knot crossing order remain approximate.

S102.title: Tube outline and cast shadow
S102.notes: Same tube path, sphere size, mask polygon and source shadow depth; outline interpolation and shadow projection differ.

S103.title: Solid and glass surface fills
S103.notes: Same source paths, polygons, hatch angles and styles. Defaults follow upstream stroke and row scales, and glass uses the upstream four-row dash cycle. At 600 ppi whole-plate RMSE is 0.21682 (baseline 0.23772); glass RMSE fell to 0.23791 and coverage is 3.87% vs 3.64% source.

S104.title: Flat surfaces
S104.notes: Same panel vertices, lighting normals, hatch angles and source styles. Stipple ink coverage now matches at 600 ppi (7.12% vs 7.08%); hatch remains under-dense (12.28% vs 14.07%), and whole-plate RMSE is 0.32819 (baseline 0.29890). Placement and edge behavior still differ.

S105.title: Wood block and surface
S105.notes: The plank and wooden surface now use the source knot-warped field at a 1 mm grid. At 600 ppi, surface RMSE is 0.07958 (prior 0.13138), with ink coverage 0.611% vs source 0.489%. Knot placement and contour widths remain approximate.

S106.title: Standing and hanging weights
S106.notes: Same positions and nominal height; body profiles and hatch algorithms differ.

S107.title: Wheels and centroid
S107.notes: The second wheel now uses the upstream radial-hatch construction. At 600 ppi its crop RMSE fell from 0.25567 to 0.12807, with 6.03% ink coverage vs 7.10% source. Pulley-wheel shading remains approximate and over-inked; centroid geometry is shared.

S108.title: Lens and annotation variants
S108.notes: Same convex, concave and plano lens dimensions and annotation geometry; curve and arrow construction differ.
